page.overview:
Who is Daimo Sharawi?

Daimo Sharawi was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in in Arrakeen. He told them of his position in the United Water Sellers Guild and explained the meaning of the phrase "Soo-soo sook!", which he was shouting as they approached.
